sources.entry: xScope - Toolset for measuring, inspecting, and testing on-screen layouts and graphics.

summary.name: xScope
summary.one_liner: xScope is a Mac toolset for measuring, aligning, inspecting, and testing on-screen layouts and graphics.
use_cases: aligning UI elements in design work
previewing app designs on iOS and Apple Watch from a Mac
simulating color vision impairments for accessibility testing
fitting layouts to device screen sizes
summary.what_it_does: xScope provides on-screen rulers with scaling, rotation, and edge snapping for pixel-precise measurement. Its Dimensions feature shows the size of any element under the cursor. Guides and Frames let users place floating alignment lines and marker boxes over other windows. Loupe magnifies part of the screen, copies colors, and simulates how colors look to users with vision impairments. Screens offers dozens of templates for computer, TV, and mobile screen sizes, and Mirror shows designs on iOS and Apple Watch while working on a Mac. Text new is a tool for searching, decoding, and reformatting text and character glyphs.
notable: Dimensions shows element size by hovering the cursor over it
Loupe simulates color appearance for users with vision impairments
Mirror previews designs on iOS and Apple Watch from the Mac
caveats: Pricing is not stated on the page text provided
Mac-focused; iOS and Apple Watch features work from the Mac
